title: Exact Mayer-Vietoris sequences with pullback-compatible connecting maps
statement: Let g:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U,V opens of X with U∪V=X, and G an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Use cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] with the coefficient composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] for all restriction maps and for P_I on I=U∩V. There exist connecting homomorphisms delta_X^q:H^q(I,G restricted to I)→H^{q+1}(X,G) and delta_Y^q:H^q(g^{-1}I,(g^{-1}G) restricted to g^{-1}I)→H^{q+1}(Y,g^{-1}G) for all q≥0. On X and Y the restriction-to-two-opens map is injective in degree zero; restriction to the pair, difference of intersection restrictions, delta, and next-degree restriction are exact at each adjacent pair. Moreover delta_Y^q(P_I(x))=g^*(delta_X^q(x)). No ordinary restriction square is part of this statement. The intersection on Y is g^{-1}(U∩V), identified with g^{-1}U∩g^{-1}V.

proof.text: Choose nonnegative injective resolutions I of G and J of g^{-1}G. Enough injectives comes from the existing Grothendieck-abelian sheaf instance and the Mathlib enough-injectives theorem, not the module-sheaf enough-injectives statement. The source upperStar has proved PreservesFiniteLimits, PreservesFiniteColimits and Additive instances, hence carries the augmentation to a quasi-isomorphism. K-injectivity of J lifts the augmentation to beta:g^{-1}I→J. Any augmentation homotopy is zero since J^{-1}=0; thus beta respects the augmentations exactly.

Use the degreewise section sequences in the construction of Tag 0A50 for I on X and J on Y. For W=X,U,V,U∩V define phi_W=beta(g^{-1}W) after the unit on sections. The inverse-image opens are the fibre products; inverse image preserves U∪V=X and U∩V. Naturality of the unit and beta makes phi commute with both restriction maps, hence with their difference. This gives a morphism of short exact complexes with the same sign convention on both sides.

Take homology of these short exact complexes. Their long exact sequences give all three exactness assertions and the initial degree-zero injections. HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.delta_naturality gives compatibility of their connecting homomorphisms with H(phi_I) and H(phi_X).

Compute the Ext/global-sections comparison on these same injective resolutions: Hom from the constant integer sheaf identifies with sections by evaluation at 1. Under this identification a coefficient morphism acts by the lifted chain map. An Ext class represented as a cocycle is sent by the exact inverse-image functor to its inverse-image cocycle; precomposition with the constant-sheaf comparison is the adjunction unit on its representing section. Composing with beta identifies this with phi_X. On W, use the restricted injective resolutions and the identity lift of the coefficient comparison. The open-restriction pullback-unit identity identifies the section map with phi_W, so H(phi_W) is exactly restricted cohomologyMap followed by the coefficient composition comparison. This verifies the pullback compatibility of the Ext/derived-sections comparison, rather than assuming that bare existence of a natural isomorphism provides it.

Transport the exact sequences and delta_naturality along those additive identifications. The horizontal maps become precisely the prescribed restriction maps and their difference, and the vertical maps become g^* and P_I. Resolution independence eliminates all choices. When an open is empty or both are all of X these are split sequences with zero connecting maps; for identity g the same resolution can be used on both sides.
